note: Adjudicated accidental and house-orthography variants. The witnesses agree on the substantive text.

adjudicated.ruling: The 1962 typical edition prints the future participle adfutúrum as one word: the Baptist foretold the Saviour who was to come. The pinned digital proper divides it into a preposition and an adjective. The selected reading is attested by the controlling witness.
Witness do reads mónstravit,; the edition follows the directly checked 1962 typical-edition page.
The typical edition's punctuation is retained. The difference marks phrasing and does not change the words.
